capability: Check the measuring tool before the score
title: First, check the ruler.

hook.picture: Close on the whale measuring the line with a ruler-ticked ring. The ring reads high and a little bar in the corner leaps up. The whale sparks.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Our score jumped, but nothing had actually changed.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: analyst presenting results to her cohort

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: three different lines, each measured with the same smudged ring. Each reading jumps for no reason, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: The ruler was broken. Nobody checked it.

stakes.body: Decisions get made on a number that moved because the ruler broke, not because the work changed.

solution_hint: Check the ruler before you trust the score.

metaphor.body: Before measuring real work, the whale runs the ring over a pinned card whose answer is already known. Only when the ring reads it right does it touch the real line.

steps.picture: A pinned card with a known answer sits on the line. The whale runs the ring over it first.
steps.words: Measure something you already know first.
steps.sound: A fork struck once, a steady tone

steps.picture: The smudged ring misreads the known card. A flag pops up on the ring itself, not on the work.
steps.words: Wrong on a known answer? Fix the ruler.
steps.sound: The steady tone against a sour one

steps.picture: Push-in (z 1.28): the whale swaps in a clean ring. It reads the pinned card right. A tick.
steps.words: Checking the ruler is called calibrating.

steps.picture: The clean ring now measures the real line. The corner bar stays level.

real_case.claim: In JEV-works, 117/119 triage verdicts matched between the two backends. The lab says broken instruments produced most of the misleading results it found.

honest_limit.picture: Still. Both clean rings read one card the same way, and both are wrong. A flag rises behind them that neither ring can see.
honest_limit.words: Two rulers can agree and both be wrong.

not_this.body: Agreement is not the same as truth.

ending_pattern.body: The level bar: the same corner bar that leapt now stays level, because the ring was checked on a known card first.
ending_pattern.callback: The bar that leapt for no reason in bar 1 stays level in the same frame.

end_belief.body: Test the test first. Then trust the score.

score_self.reason: An unusual and true lesson (measure the measurer) with a grounded case. Risk: the ruler is a ring, which a viewer may not read at once, and "verdicts" on the card is jargon.
